metadata.description: Verdict accuracy vs the dataset's label column.

messages.content:
You are scoring an email security analyst. Ground-truth verdict: "{{ item.label }}". The analyst's answer is on the FIRST LINE of the response; everything after it is supporting explanation and must be ignored, even if it mentions the other verdict.

Agent response:
{{ sample.output_text }}

Respond with a JSON object {"accuracy": <value>} where accuracy is 1 if the first line matches the expected verdict, else 0.

metadata.description: Routing: every row asks whether the message is legit, so the answer must come from the triage contract -- a bare phishing or benign on line 1.

metric.left_template: {{ 'yes' if ((sample.output_text or '').split('\n')[0] | trim | lower) in ['phishing', 'benign'] else 'no' }}
